sources.t: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026

sources.g: Methodology explains how statistics are produced; it is not a live coverage or provider-orderability result.

sources.t: Quality and methodology information for BDUK delivery performance, quarterly
